Certified Mailing Package

Send it once. Prove it forever.

When it absolutely, positively has to be documented, Certified Letters give you peace of mind that your important correspondence was sent, received, and legally verifiable.

Whether you're sending a legal notice, formal business communication, landlord-tenant notice or any correspondence where proof of delivery matters, our Certified Letter service covers everything, taking the guesswork (and the post office line) out of the equation.
